$comment: Copy me per build and rater. Anchors: ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md section 3, idle boundaries: docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md. One quoted observation per axis. bot: green|amber|red|na is a cap, never an award. Answer criterion + idle probes BEFORE awarding.
evaluator: blind rater a (Claude agent), seed 227, headed GPU D3D12 RTX 3080, phone 400x800 @3x

activeIntervalsUTC.exclusions: ~19:35:20-19:38:20 driver label-click debugging (infrastructure); ~0.5 min backgrounded-call wait

horizon.editNotes: 1 add 'hp<50% → cleave' (condition change to 'adjacent ≥' attempted, did not take); 2 add corridor fighting card; 3 MOVE boss row above it (death-screen fix); 4 apply 'hp<30% → drink unknown' (first edit after return); 5 move drink heal above cleave; 6 drop cleave, move return up. Pen ('edit') became available after buying 'rule: corridor fighting' unlock (~25 min in).
horizon.screenshots: scratchpad/77030eb-blind-a/shots (first-minute, first-death, first-edit, return-20m, return-8h, first-edit-after-return, verdict-queen, king-death)

sameDayRetelling: Fenn Ash, my tenth heir, went down with the heal rule I had just moved above my own cleave row. At D28 the Lurker Queen cornered him three times and each time 'HP 30% → drink' pulled him back until 'LURKER QUEEN DOWN'. He pushed on through the Sanctum to D33 with $16404 secured and died to the Mirror King at 17 hp.
pronounCount: retelling: my/I/I'd x3 first-person on config ('my tenth heir', 'I had just moved', 'my own cleave row')

humanProbes.clarity: Mostly yes: the death banner read 'lurker · D28 · hero at 1 hp' plus 'return at 25% never fired'; but my personality changed under me from 'unbowed' to 'light hands' to 'iron gut' and I never saw why.
humanProbes.decisions: Adding 'hp < 50% → cleave' moved the forecast from 'return 63% · death 25%' to 'return 75% · death 13%', and I later dropped that same row when the verdict showed it shadowing my heal and return rows — I would make the drop again.
humanProbes.mastery: An hour ago I did not know row order mattered; now I read 'drink heal at 45% under cleave at 50%' and know a high row starves the ones below it.
humanProbes.tension: I sweated the D28 Queen fight watching 'HP 30% → drink', 'HP 43% → drink', 'HP 26% → drink' with three potions, then 'LURKER QUEEN DOWN'; the four heirs who died overnight carried no tension at all.
humanProbes.feel: The 'GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN' banner and callouts like 'CORRIDOR FIGHTING JACKAL' land, but the log fills with 'always → corridor fighting ×7' and the watch jumps to 16×/40× on its own; audio unassessed.
humanProbes.surprise: The lanes changed what I configured — the D13 'gas' death and D28 Queen 'blind · summoner' sent me to heal ordering and quiet steps; but every run re-climbed the same Warlord D8, Mother D13, Lich D18, Master D23 ladder.
humanProbes.expression: My build: a fighter who drinks unknown below 30%, heals below 45%, goes home below 25%, kills bosses above 45% and fights everything from corridors — though most of those rows were the game's suggested fixes.
humanProbes.story: Fenn Ash, the tenth heir, survived the Queen on three heal potions, reached D33 with '$16404' secured and died to the Mirror King 'at 17 hp'.
humanProbes.pacing: In-run: a whole D1–D7 compresses to one chip 'D1–7 · 100% · +$204' and fights play at 2×; administratively the 'keep' sheet after each return waited for a tap and each new heir re-climbed 28 floors before anything new.
humanProbes.failure: The Queen verdict ran '12 replays of D28' and ranked fixes like 'hp < 30% → drink unknown · survives 8/12 · was 1/12'; my own corridor card was blamed by name: 'move above tactic corridor fighting foe: boss → attack boss'.
humanProbes.social: Nobody; heirs are named (Una, Vale, Wren, Yara, Fenn, Galen Ash) but they are interchangeable.
humanProbes.autonomy: I chose to chase the Queen with 'quiet steps' and later 'mirror read' and to buy a 'silence scroll $39' that the game only hinted at with 'counter: read silence'.
humanProbes.progression: Best depth went D4 → D6 → D8 → D13 → D23 → D28 → D33 in 70 minutes, with porter, scout, apprentice hired and forge steps; but the 8h absence left best at D28 and earned '$1496'.
humanProbes.aesthetic: The night town grows lit cottages around a campfire and the death banner with the jackal portrait is lovely; I would sit in the town, less so in the text-heavy watch.
humanProbes.return: After 20m I came back to 'While away · D28 · $10949' and a 'Pick one' (drill / legacy / forge −10%); after 8h only '$1496' and four dead heirs, so longer absence paid less — I chose the forge discount each time and edited rules from the verdicts.
humanProbes.attribution: The last Queen death was my fault: my 'cleave at 50%' row sat above 'return at 25%', which 'never fired'; the Queen kill was my decision too — the heal row I moved up fired three times.

blindnessViolations: none known; read only RATING.md, FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, FRAMEWORK §1-3, template, presets.json idle-hybrid weights, and tools/driver.mjs + drive.sh usage headers (harness, not game source). Used page.locator DOM clicks via driver js op for multi-line buttons (DOM/user-visible only; no __riddle or engine APIs).

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Death lines + named never-fired rows are clear ('return at 25% never fired'), but personality silently changed unbowed → light hands → iron gut, supplies/pick-one controls were easy to miss, and early 'compare outcomes' said only 'noise · 8 runs'.

Rule edits carried live forecast trade-offs ('return 63%→75% · death 25%→13%'; corridor card: 'full haul 13% → <13%, return 88%'). Lapse: forge and Legacy spending is a strictly ordered buy-what-you-can sequence.
I learned row-order shadowing from three verdicts ('drink heal at 45% under cleave at 50%'), but the game's ranked fix list did most of the diagnosis for me.
Watched Queen fight ('HP 30% → drink' ×3, 'LURKER QUEEN DOWN') was real stakes; offline deaths (queen ×2, gas, lich over 8h) were read after the fact with no tension.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Callouts and boss banners ('GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN', 'CORRIDOR FIGHTING JACKAL') read well at 2×; log spam 'always → corridor fighting ×7' and auto 16×/40× jumps blur it. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Five lanes with new foes (Fens eels, Crypt lich, Foundry golems, Deep queen, Sanctum king) changed my config; but each run re-climbed the identical D8/D13/D18/D23 boss ladder.
My 4 written rows + corridor card are recognisably mine, but most were accepted game fixes and 'tactic corridor fighting 71%' of rule time is a package.

Fenn Ash: three heal potions at the Queen, D33, died to the Mirror King at 17 hp — a run with a turn. Lapse: offline runs come back as one-line reels ('Lich cornered him to 2 HP; held; died to Lich').

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: Compressed early floors ('D1–7 · 100% · +$204') and ~1–4 min runs are good; the keep sheet blocks auto-continue, each heir re-climbs 28 floors, and the 20m absence initially showed a dimmed 'VERDICT' screen with nothing changed.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace

Named heirs only; no relationship. Weight 0.
I chose route/tactics/supplies (quiet steps, mirror read, silence scroll) the game did not order, within a fairly fixed descent.

Within-run (D-depth, carry), persistent (forge steps, Legacy ranks, tactic levels, unlocks), automation (porter, scout, apprentice) all observed; D4→D33 in 70 min. Lapse: the 8h absence moved nothing ($1496, best still D28).
Pixel town that grows lit houses, death banners with foe portraits, boss art. Lapse: the watch screen is crowded with text over the map. Audio unassessed.
